create_ReIDDataset: create a ReIDDataset instance with triplet_sampler config for person re-identification training
load_data_list_ReIDDataset: load ReID annotations from a text file mapping filenames to ground truth person labels
parse_ann_info_ReIDDataset: parse person id annotations to build an index mapping each pid to its sample indices
prepare_data_ReIDDataset: prepare a ReID data sample by optionally applying triplet sampling then running the pipeline
triplet_sampling_ReIDDataset: sample a triplet batch of images with positive and negative person ids for triplet loss
